timer.title: Teaching Timer
timer.description: Use a timed challenge before students share ideas.
timer.prompt: When the timer ends, students can raise their hand and explain their idea.
timer.times-up: Time is up. Invite answers from the class.

teaching-tools.title: Teaching Tools
teaching-tools.description: Use quick mouse actions for highlights, arrows, and diagonals while teaching.
teaching-tools.action-piece-pattern: Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + right click piece pattern
teaching-tools.action-piece-captures: Cmd/Ctrl + Alt + Shift + right click captures
teaching-tools.help-right-click: Right click any square to highlight it. Right click the same square again to remove it.
teaching-tools.help-multi: Hold Command on Mac or Ctrl on Windows/Linux, then right click to add or remove more squares.
teaching-tools.help-rank: Hold Alt, then right click any square to highlight the whole rank.
teaching-tools.help-file: Hold Alt + Shift, then right click any square to highlight the whole file.
teaching-tools.help-arrow: Right drag from one square to another to draw or remove an arrow.
teaching-tools.help-diagonal: Hold Shift while right dragging between two diagonal squares to highlight that diagonal.
teaching-tools.help-rectangle: Hold Alt while right dragging from one corner to another to highlight the whole rectangle area.
teaching-tools.help-segment: Hold Command on Mac or Ctrl on Windows/Linux while right dragging to highlight only the dragged part of a rank, file, or diagonal.
teaching-tools.help-piece-pattern: Hold Command on Mac or Ctrl on Windows/Linux, plus Shift, then right click a piece to highlight its attack pattern from the current position.
teaching-tools.help-piece-captures: Hold Command on Mac or Ctrl on Windows/Linux, plus Alt and Shift, then right click a piece to highlight only its capture squares. This only works for the side to move.
teaching-tools.help-piece-checks: Hold Command on Mac or Ctrl on Windows/Linux, plus Alt, then right click a piece to highlight only the legal checking squares for that piece. This only works for the side to move.
teaching-tools.help-clear: Press C or Esc to clear all highlights and arrows.
